sections.title: The inverse
facts: Subtraction is checked by adding; division by multiplying.
$a - b = c$ means $c + b = a$. $a \div b = c$ means $c \times b = a$.

sections.title: Casting out nines
facts: Replace each number by its digit sum remainder by $9$.
The remainders of a sum add; the remainders of a product multiply.
If the check fails, the answer is wrong. If it passes, it is probably right.

sections.title: Strategy menu
facts: Near a round number: compensate. Times $9$, $99$: $\times 10$ or $\times 100$, take one away.
Pairs: $25 \times 4 = 100$, $5 \times 2 = 10$. Middle number: $(m - b)(m + b) = m^2 - b^2$.

sections.title: Speed facts
facts: Squares to $15$, ending-in-$5$ squares, and complements to $100$ and $1000$.
